load_lpips_vgg_model: load the LPIPS VGG model from a given file path for image similarity evaluation
calc_psnr_ssim_lpips: calculate PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS metrics between source and target image tensors
create_load_lpips_model: create a function call to load_lpips_vgg_model with a model path string argument
test_calc_psnr_ssim_lpips: test calc_psnr_ssim_lpips with source and target image tensors and a loaded LPIPS model
summarize_image_metrics: summarize the image_metrics module that computes PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS image quality metrics
